The '''Forest of Shadows''', or '''Great Blackwood'''{{ref/book|3|35}}, is a large, impenetrable forest that lies between the [[Two Rivers]] and [[Ghealdan]] just east of the [[Mountains of Mist]]. It lies south of the [[Manetherendrelle|White River]] and the village of [[Deven Ride]]. Although it was once presumably possible to traverse the river and forest, as the whole region was once part of the kingdom of [[Manetheren]], in modern times the river flows so fast it is almost uncrossable, and the forest is so overgrown, wild, and dangerous that people simply don't bother making the attempt.

[[Garen's Wall]] is located in the eastern part of the forest. Due to its remoteness and unexplored nature, the forest is sometimes rumored to hold great treasures, and several [[Hunters of the Horn]] visited the forest under the impression that the [[Horn of Valere]] may be hidden there.
